detail.longDescription:
Headscale/tailscale and docker are about as close to magic as it gets!

#forgejo just released a new version, and here I am on a train with my phone. 

VPNed into my home network (where my server sits) from my phone. A quick `docker compose pull && docker compose up -d` later and a minute later it’s up to date. All with only my phone in my hands. 

I have done this sort of thing a few times now, but I still think it’s pretty amazing!

#Headscale #Tailscale #docker #SelfHosting
